messages:
maya (pm): quick sync — putting together the PRD for the Optimize Toolkit (batching, caching, quantization recommendations). want to align on scope + launch criteria before next week

liam (eng-ml): high level ok. need to be explicit about supported model families + quant bits we recommend (fp16, int8, int4). also perf targets per model size.

olivia (eng-platform): ops constraints: canary rollout must support traffic-split + automatic fallback to hosted runtime. adding rollout playbook is non-negotiable.

maya (pm): proposed scope: 1) recommendation engine (rules + prescriptive profiles) for batching/caching/quantization 2) CLI + Console UI to surface profiles 3) auto-suggest for config per workload. launch MVP: rules + docs + Console toggle.

noah (customer-success): +1 for UI. customers keep asking for clear "do X to save Y" guidance. request: include example savings for chat vs. embeddings workloads.

sara (sales): enterprise asks: ability to lock recommendations (prevent auto-apply), audit log of changes, and explicit SLA statements for Dedicated customers. flagging for compliance.

liam (eng-ml): acceptance criteria suggestion:
```
- Perf: 2x median tokens/sec improvement on streaming small-chat workloads when using batching + kv-prefix cache vs baseline.
- Cost: 15-30% per-token cost reduction recommended ranges for int8/4 quantization on candidate models.
- Quality: end-to-end KL/ROUGE/Emb-cosine regression < 3% relative to baseline for recommended quant profiles (measured on canonical eval set).
- Safety: no unbounded degradation for safety-sensitive prompts (define safety prompt set).
```

amanda (qa): need concrete tests. I'll own a test matrix: model family x sequence length x quant level x caching enabled/disabled x failure modes (OOM, partial responses). we should add automated regression harness.

james (support): edge cases to capture in PRD: 1) partial kv cache invalidation causing stale completions 2) quantization-induced hallucination increase on translation models 3) errors on streaming fallback when batch boundaries change mid-stream. need clear mitigation + runbook.

olivia (eng-platform): ops acceptance criteria:
```
- Rollout: feature flag + canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency or error-rate SLO breaches.
- Monitoring: per-model cost delta + 95th latency per route reported in Console within 5 min.
- Fallback: immediate failover to non-optimized path within 30s of detecting regression.
```

noah (customer-success): customers care about visibility into recommendations applied per-route. can we expose a per-route "explain" that shows why a profile was suggested?

liam (eng-ml): yes. we can store provenance: workload fingerprint -> recommended profile -> estimated savings + risk score. risk score computed from eval regressions and model family heuristics.

maya (pm): launch gating proposal (MVP GA in two phases):
- Phase 1 (internal beta): docs + recommendation engine + console view + manual apply. gating: integration tests pass, perf + quality on canonical eval set, + 3 pilot customers onboarded.
- Phase 2 (public beta / GA): add auto-suggest + rollout tooling + audit logs + enterprise locks. gating: canary rollout stability for 72h, no >2% regression customer-visible metrics.

sara (sales): timeline asks: some large prospects expect phase 2 features before contract signing. can we promise a guarded timeline?

olivia (eng-platform): timeline depends on infra work. estimate 6w for phase1, 10-12w for phase2 after signoff. blockers: metrics pipeline changes, policy for automatic fallback, console UI slots.

liam (eng-ml): engineering risks: quantization regressions harder for seq2seq and instruction-following models. for MVP we'll restrict auto-suggest to decoder-only and open-source verified families; recommend manual-apply for others. need explicit blacklist.

james (support): runbook snippets to include in PRD:
```
- symptom: higher hallucination after applying int4 profile
  - quick-checks: compare baseline logits on seed prompts, run eval on safety set
  - mitigation: revert profile, apply int8 / force fp16
- symptom: streaming stalls when batching changes
  - mitigation: drain pending tokens, toggle batching off for route
```

amanda (qa): QA acceptance checklist (short):
- perf regression <3% across canonical workloads
- CI harness for quantization correctness (bit-exact where expected)
- e2e canary test that simulates 5->25->100% rollout and triggers rollback on error spike

maya (pm): open product tradeoffs to capture in PRD:
- strict vs. permissive recommendations (we choose permissive auto-suggest for GA, strict locked mode for enterprise).
- automated vs. manual rollout (start manual for high-risk models).
- surface-level savings estimate vs. guaranteed savings wording.

noah (customer-success): request: include sample customer stories in PRD: one PLG SaaS (chat widget) and one enterprise (dedicated infra, compliance). helps sales + support.

liam (eng-ml): edge-case technical notes to include as appendix:
- KV-prefix caching mismatch when model context window differs across variants -> recommend canonicalize context length in profiles.
- quantization + flash-attn kernel incompatibilities -> have fallback code path for kernels with known issues.

olivia (eng-platform): ops note: ensure we tag metrics with profile_id and run_id so we can back-trace recommendations to experiments.

maya (pm): action items:
- liam: draft technical appendix (quant bits, model family matrix, blacklist) by Tue EOD.
- olivia: timeline + infra tasks + rollout playbook draft by Wed.
- amanda: QA matrix + harness plan by Wed.
- noah: two sample customer stories + pilot candidate list by Thu.
- sara: list of enterprise commitments to include in PRD by Thu.
- james: initial runbook snippets and support doc by Thu.
- maya: consolidate PRD + acceptance criteria, share for review Fri morning.

eng-bot: reminder: PRD review requested by maya (pm) scheduled for Fri 11:00am PT. Add to calendar? :bell:

sara (sales): noted, will coordinate pilot customers that need phase2 earlier.

liam (eng-ml): one more: we should include an experiment plan for measuring "perceived quality" after quantization (human eval bucket) — I'll add that to appendix.

maya (pm): perfect. thanks everyone — i'll start the PRD skeleton and ping when drafts are up. feel free to drop short comments here if anything else pops up :slightly_smiling_face:
